message: '{0}' cannot contain unsafe code because it is {1} code.
title: Compile-time code cannot contain unsafe code.
rationale: The placeholder {1} is a scope adjective such as 'compile-time' or 'run-time-or-compile-time' (TemplatingCodeValidator.Visitor.VerifyModifiers passes TemplatingScope.ToDisplayString()), so the sentence ends with a dangling adjective ('because it is run-time-or-compile-time.'); adding 'code' makes it grammatical. The title lacks the final period.
codeChange: VerifyModifiers only inspects the 'unsafe' modifier of declarations (types, methods, properties, fields, and so on). 'unsafe' statement blocks and unsafe local functions in compile-time code are not detected by LAMA0248 or LAMA0249. Consider checking UnsafeStatementSyntax and local function modifiers too.
